messages.alertTemplateHelpText:
Available variables:
{$fieldName} - Any entity field (e.g. {$name}, {$status})
{$$entityLink} - Clickable link to entity
{$$user} - Current user
{$$entity} - Target record

Example:
New record added: {$name}
View: {$$entityLink}

tooltips.manualElementType:
**Button**: Will appear as a standalone button in the record detail view
**Dropdown-Item**: Will appear as an item in the dropdown menu in the record detail view
